$comment: Measured, not asserted: test/behavior.test.mjs runs a probe per feature against the engine in testedEngine and fails when a recorded value disagrees. Two values here were stale falses until that probe existed.
policy: Prefer released-engine behavior. A spec-only construct must not be authored unless the target explicitly supports it.

delimited_comment.guidance: Shipped in 0.1.4. Older engines need %% instead.

container_exact_closer.guidance: Shipped in 0.1.4: an equal-width nested container nests. An equal-width CODE fence still closes early.

admonition_landmark_name.syntax: ::: note with an optional quoted title
admonition_landmark_name.guidance: Shipped in 0.1.6: untitled admonitions use aria-label; titled admonitions use aria-labelledby pointing to the visible title.

tier3_renderers.syntax: mermaid, chart, rendered math, host directives

vertical_cell_alignment.syntax: |=<^ and |=>v, a second table alignment axis
vertical_cell_alignment.guidance: Shipped in 0.1.5. Was prose-only guidance saying 0.1.4 left the markers as literal cell text, which stayed in the skill for a release after it stopped being true.

nested_bare_emphasis.syntax: _*x*_, one bare mark directly inside another
nested_bare_emphasis.guidance: PART 3's word-boundary guard exempts a delimiter that opens directly after a `_` or `/` which itself opens a span that closes. `_*x*_` nests; `_*x* q` stays literal.

fence_opener_fallback_lint.syntax: carve lint reporting a fence opener whose info string is not valid
fence_opener_fallback_lint.guidance: Shipped in 0.1.9: ```js {.diff} now reports `fence-opener-fallback`. It still degrades to an inline code span, so the finding names the degradation rather than preventing it. 0.1.7 reported nothing.

directive_title.syntax: ::: footnotes "Title" - a quoted title on a placement marker
directive_title.guidance:
Shipped in 0.1.9: a placing marker's quoted title renders as the placed element's first child with aria-labelledby, and an opener label follows it as

. 0.1.7 dropped both when the marker placed (markup-carve/carve-js#2073), so a title is safe to write only from 0.1.9 on.

footnotes_placement_lint.syntax: carve lint reporting a ::: footnotes marker written inside a container
footnotes_placement_lint.guidance: Shipped in 0.1.9 for footnotes only: a ::: footnotes marker inside a container reports `footnotes-placement-in-container`. The sibling rules `bibliography-placement-in-container` and `references-placement-in-container` are still unreported, so for those two kinds only the render shows that the marker did not place.

doubled_arrows.guidance: Shipped in 0.1.5, and `=>` STOPPED converting in the same release. Write ->, <-, <->, ==>, <== or <=>; `=>` is literal text now.
